extension.description: Play all your media from OneDrive including Videos, Music and Pictures. - Unlimited number of personal or business accounts. - Search over your drive. - Auto-Refreshed slideshow. - Export your videos to your library (.strm files) - Use OneDrive as a source - This program is not affiliated with or sponsored by Microsoft.
extension.summary: כונן OneDrive של מיקרוסופט עבור קודי
extension.description: הפעל את כל המדיה שלך מ- OneDrive כולל וידאו, מוסיקה ותמונות. - מספר בלתי מוגבל של חשבונות אישיים או עסקיים. - חיפוש ומציאת הכונן שלך. - ריענון מצגת אוטומטית. - ייצוא קטעי הווידאו לספרייה שלך (קבצי .strm) - שימוש ב-OneDrive כמקור - תוכנית זו אינה מזוהה עם או בחסות מיקרוסופט.

Spela upp alla dina medier från OneDrive, inklusive videor, musik och bilder. - Obegränsat antal personliga konton eller företagskonton. - Sök i din OneDrive. - Automatiskt uppdaterat bildspel. - Exportera dina videor till biblioteket (.strm-filer) - Använd OneDrive som källa - Detta program är inte anslutet till eller sponsrat av Microsoft.
extension.news:
v2.4.11 released Oct 31, 2026: - Videos show the plot, cast and artwork of the Kodi .nfo files and pictures next to them (it can be turned off in the settings) - Requires clouddrive.common 1.5.18
v2.4.10 released Oct 30, 2026: - Big folders open a page at a time: Items per page in the Advanced settings (500 by default, 0 for the whole folder) - Going back to a folder, after viewing a picture for example, doesn't load it again for a few minutes (Cache expiration time) - .vtt subtitles are loaded too - Requires clouddrive.common 1.5.13
v2.4.9 released Oct 30, 2026: - Subtitles next to a video are found in its folder, also with OneDrive for Business accounts where search missed them
v2.4.8 released Oct 30, 2026: - Folders shared with you and added to your files show their name, and open in Use as a source - Auto-refreshed slideshow: notices replaced pictures, not only a different number of them
v2.4.7 released Oct 30, 2026: - Adding an account shows only its OneDrive: personal accounts moved to Microsoft's new storage listed several system drives (Bundles, ODCMetadataArchive...)
v2.4.6 released Oct 16, 2026: - Use as a source: folders with spaces or special characters in their names open, and files no longer put download links in the Kodi log - Requires clouddrive.common 1.5.7
v2.4.5 released Oct 15, 2026: - Swedish translation (thanks to Daniel Nylander)
v2.4.4 released Oct 15, 2026: - New icon and fanart
extension.disclaimer:
This cloud drive addon uses a third-party authentication mechanism commonly known as OAuth 2.0. If you want to know more about OAuth 2.0 you can visit the following pages: - https://oauth.net/2/ - https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/OAuth2 - https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/onedrive/developer/rest-api/getting-started/msa-oauth
Kodi and myself take no responsibility or liability.
The authentication server URL is specified in Settings / Advanced / Sign-in Server. The Sign-in Server implements the OAuth 2.0 protocol. The complete source code of the Sign-in Server can be download here: https://github.com/cguZZman/drive-login You can clone the project and host it in your own server.

extension.summary: Play your videos, music and pictures from Dropbox
extension.description: Browse your Dropbox in Kodi and play your videos, music and pictures. - Any number of Dropbox accounts - Search your Dropbox - Shared with me: folders and files others share with you - Subtitles stored next to your videos are loaded automatically - Export videos and music to the Kodi library (.strm files) - Use Dropbox as a source - Read-only: the add-on never changes or deletes your files Sign in from your phone or computer with a short code shown in Kodi.
extension.disclaimer: This add-on is not affiliated with or endorsed by Dropbox.
extension.summary: Reproduce tus videos, música e imágenes de Dropbox
extension.description: Explora tu Dropbox en Kodi y reproduce tus videos, música e imágenes. - Cualquier número de cuentas de Dropbox - Busca en tu Dropbox - Compartido contigo: carpetas y archivos que otros comparten contigo - Los subtítulos guardados junto a tus videos se cargan automáticamente - Exporta videos y música a la biblioteca de Kodi (archivos .strm) - Usa Dropbox como fuente - Solo lectura: el complemento nunca cambia ni elimina tus archivos Inicia sesión desde tu teléfono o computadora con un código corto que muestra Kodi.
extension.disclaimer: Este complemento no está afiliado a Dropbox ni cuenta con su respaldo.

extension.summary: Spela upp dina videor, din musik och dina bilder från Dropbox
